title: Nutty Pillowy Ukrainian Chicken Pilaf
description: A tangy and adventurous Ukrainian dish featuring massaman curry paste, low in sodium.
instructions: Rinse the chicken breast and pat dry with paper towels.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the massaman curry paste in 2 tablespoons of chicken broth over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Add the sliced almonds and cook until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, water, grated ginger, and salt-free seasoning blend. Bring to a boil.
Add the rice, chicken breast, and diced fresh parsley to the Dutch oven.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the rice is tender.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
